# CLI flags

Flags are the tool's public interface, and scripts depend on them.

## Rules

1. Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable (for `--dry-run`, `ARCHIVE_DRY_RUN`), because CI sets options through the environment. Flags that predate this rule are exempt and are being migrated separately.
2. Flag names are kebab-case.
3. On/off switches use `action="store_true"` and never take a value.

# Logging

## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor its required environment default so CI-configured exclusions take effect.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable `--exclude GLOB` filtering, logs skipped files, documents the flag, and adds parser and archive tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, parsing returns `[]`, so matching files remain included. This violates .agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11: “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to omit.
